name: conflict-detector-v2
artifact_lineage: mirror of merge_arbiter_train.py per docs/experiments/conflict-detector-trainer-delta-map.md; dispatch docs/experiments/conflict-detector-train-dispatch-2026-11-06.md; corpus v2 per docs/experiments/conflict-detector-corpus-design-ADDENDUM-3.md §8 (ratified amend-then-ratify, E1-E13); trainer input params via CLI (--corpus-dir/--pin/--seal/--artifact-dir), semantics unchanged

decision_rule.rule: contradicts iff P(contradicts) >= 0.5 (guard leg aside); NO threshold search, NO label shift (ratified MLC-9)
decision_rule.gates_fit: pipeline (guard+model) is the gated object (dispatch §4 note 1); model-only numbers are diagnostics

guard.predicate: ALL difflib non-equal regions of the norm1 bodies consist of version-namespace tokens (semver \bv?\d+\.\d+(\.\d+)?\b or version keywords) -> NOT contradicts, unconditionally; no regions -> no fire
guard.source: scripts/conflict_corpus_lib.py (frozen; sha pinned in the prologue tripwire as conflict_corpus_lib_sha256)
guard.one_sided: NOT-leg only; the contradicts side of the guard is read nowhere in the contour

guard_off_honesty_train.honesty: the number of NC-3 contradicts proposals the guard suppresses (MLC-9 p.13; published before gate_start)

in_sample_train_diagnostic.note: in-sample diagnostic; the honest generalization numbers are the CV OOF row (train-side) and the sealed holdout (gate)

convention.embed_surface: n1(title)\n+n1(body)\n+n1(space-joined tags), [:4096]; n1 = lower + whitespace-collapse (frozen lib.embed_text; corpus measured with the same surface — max embed text len asserted < 4096 at train)
convention.cos_target: MEASURED vector-leg cosine over the pair (pinned nano, dot of norm1 vectors); corpus rows ride measured.cos_target; fresh material measures via NanoLeg

corpus.regime: synthetic-only; no store texts; no LLM; labels by construction

gates_state: sealed — single-shot NOT executed at freeze time (dispatch §3; holdout CD-holdout-v2 reads exactly once at the gate)
